resources.string: You\'ll need a Beeper account that\'s already connected to your chat apps. Set that up first, on a computer with Beeper Desktop.
Sign-in failed. Check your username and password.
Beeper usually signs you in by email, so you may not have a password yet.
Enter your Beeper email address and choose a password. Beeper will email you a link; open it, then come back and press Done.
Check the email address, and make the password at least 8 characters.
Check your email and open the link from Beeper (it can take a few minutes). Then press Done.
Beeper has no account with that email address.
That didn\'t work. Try again in a moment.
The link hasn\'t been opened yet. Open it from the email, then press Done again.
Password set. Now sign in with it.
The first time can take a few minutes. Please be patient, and leave your phone on.
So you hear about new messages. Select to allow.
Battery optimisation would stop messages arriving when the phone sleeps. Select to allow.
Don\'t pause this app if unused
Android pauses apps you haven\'t opened for a while. Select, then turn off \"Pause app activity if unused\".
This phone has DuraSpeed, which closes background apps. Select to open the phone\'s Settings, scroll to the bottom, open DuraSpeed and switch on this app.
Settings opened. In DuraSpeed (near the bottom of the list), make sure this app is switched on.
If you also have WhatsApp, Signal or similar on this phone, turn off their notifications so each message only alerts you once.
Doesn\'t work reliably with Beeper. The recovery key is the dependable way.
No contacts found. Contacts come from the apps you\'ve connected in Beeper.
Creates an encrypted direct chat and invites them.
Type the full Matrix ID of the person you want to chat with, for example @name:matrix.org, then select it.
Couldn\'t start that chat. Try again later.
Your existing chats are shown; loading contacts from your connected apps…
Beeper isn\'t letting this app list your contacts. You can open any existing chat here; to message someone new, start the chat in Beeper on another device and it will appear here within seconds.
Couldn\'t start that chat from here. Start it in Beeper on another device and it will appear in your list.
Enter the email address of your Beeper account. Beeper will email you a code.
That doesn\'t look like an email address.
Couldn\'t reach Beeper. Check the address and your connection, then try again.
Type the code from the email Beeper sent you. It can take a few minutes to arrive.
The code is longer than that.
Beeper didn\'t accept that code. Check it, or go back and ask for a new one.

Sign in with your Beeper username (the part before :beeper.com) and your Beeper password. If you haven\'t set a password, open Beeper on another device, choose \"forgot password\", and create one first.

Beeper has stopped accepting this sign-in method from other apps. You can still sign in with your Beeper username and a password. If you haven\'t set one, use Beeper\'s \"forgot password\" option to create it first.
Fill in the server, username and password.
Sign-in failed. Check the details and try again.
This server only offers sign-in through a web browser, which this app can\'t do.
To read your encrypted chats, approve this phone. Enter your recovery key, or approve it from Beeper on another device if you\'re asked to.
Check that these match the ones shown on your other device.
Approval didn\'t complete. Your recovery key is the dependable way.
Approval was cancelled on the other device.

To read your encrypted chats, enter your Beeper recovery key: 48 letters and numbers in groups of four (spaces don\'t matter).\n\nOn Beeper Desktop: Settings → Beeper Profile → the menu at the top right → Show Recovery Key. Not there? Check your password manager, or make a new key in Beeper.
A recovery key has 48 characters. You\'ve typed %1$d.
Checking the key… If this phone has just signed in, it waits for the first sync to finish, which can take a few minutes.
That key wasn\'t accepted. Check it character by character and try again. If this phone has only just signed in, wait a minute and try once more.
No chats yet. Connect your apps in Beeper and they\'ll appear here.
No one else in this chat to mention.
Messages in which someone mentions you by name. Give these their own sound here if you like.
Couldn\'t send the reaction. Try again.
Editing. Press Save when done, or Cancel.
Couldn\'t fetch the file. Try again.
Nothing on this phone can open %1$s, so it has been saved to Downloads/Operator instead.
Operator needs permission to save files to Downloads.
%1$s saved to Downloads/Operator. To install it, open it from the Files app.
Emails a short technical report. No messages are included.

Please describe what happened, and what you expected:



The attached report has the phone model, Android version, Operator version and recent technical log lines. It contains no messages.
No email app found. The report was saved to Downloads/Operator as %1$s; please send it by another route.
Saved to Downloads/Operator as %1$s. Please send it to %2$s from a computer or another phone.
Opens your email app with the report attached, addressed to %1$s.
Share the report file through any app on this phone. Address it to %1$s.
Saves the report file to Downloads/Operator, to send to %1$s from a computer.
Couldn\'t build the report. Try again.

Operator receives its \"new message\" signal through a ntfy server. The default is the public ntfy.sh. If you run your own ntfy server, enter its address here; leave it empty to go back to the default. Nothing but a content-free ping passes through it.
Enter a full address starting with https://, or leave it empty for the default.
There is no web browser on this phone to open the link with.
Couldn\'t send. Check your connection and try again.
Sync warnings and the background connection
Checking for messages failed. Will retry.
Theme, light or dark, text size
On. With auto-rotate on, turning the phone sideways on the chat list previews the highlighted chat without marking it read.
Turn the phone upright to close. Nothing here counts as read.
On. Screens and menus glide into place.
Approved. Encrypted chats can be read.
Not approved yet. Select to approve.
Removes this phone from your account and deletes its messages.
Sign out and delete all messages from this phone?
Opens the phone\'s settings for the Messages channel.
On. The screen comes on for a few seconds when a message arrives.
Check for messages in the background
On. Messages arrive by push, with a check every 15 minutes.
Off. Messages arrive only while the app is open.
Select to choose a different one.
Select to choose between the built-in channel and an installed app.
This phone stops apps in the background to save battery, which would stop your messages too. Allow this app to keep running. It uses very little power: it only wakes when a message arrives.
Sends a push through the server and times its return.
This app is exempt, so messages can arrive while the phone sleeps.
Not exempt. Select to allow this app to run in the background, or messages will stop arriving when the phone sleeps.
This phone has DuraSpeed, which closes background apps. In the phone\'s Settings, scroll to the bottom, open DuraSpeed and switch on this app.
